# MapView

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMapView` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMapView.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasMapView.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasMapView.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A map of a place - OpenStreetMap's tiles, dragged, zoomed, a pin put by a click; `DrawMap` draws one into any rectangle (a card in a list's row) ([doc](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasMapView.md))

## Overview

ui-reuse-exempt: the map itself - the server's tiles drawn where Web Mercator puts them, the pin over them; there is no element to compose it of.

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMapView(const std::string& identifier, float x = 0, float y = 0, float w = 0, float h = 0);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onPinMoved` | `std::function<void(const GeoPoint&)> onPinMoved` | A click put the pin here |
| `onViewChanged` | `std::function<void()> onViewChanged` | The centre or the zoom changed (a drag, the wheel, Zoom, CentreOn) |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
